instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Haidar Akab Alwan
subject: 02_English_Language

questions.question: How is the past perfect formed?
questions.explanation: The past perfect is had with the past participle for every subject.
questions.explanation_ar: الماضي التام هو had مع اسم المفعول لكل الضمائر.

questions.question: When do we use the past perfect?
options: a habit in the present time
the earlier of the two events
the later of the two events
a plan for the near future
options_en: a habit in the present time
the earlier of the two events
the later of the two events
a plan for the near future
questions.explanation: The past perfect marks whichever of two past events happened first.
questions.explanation_ar: الماضي التام يحدد الحدث الأسبق من بين حدثين ماضيين.

questions.question: Which is the negative form of the past perfect?
questions.explanation: The negative adds not after had, giving hadn't plus the past participle.
questions.explanation_ar: النفي يضيف not بعد had، فتصبح hadn't مع اسم المفعول.

questions.question: How do we ask a past perfect question?
questions.explanation: The question inverts had with the subject and keeps the past participle.
questions.explanation_ar: السؤال يقدّم had على الفاعل ويُبقي اسم المفعول.

questions.question: By the time she arrived, I had had lunch. Which happened first?
options: both had happened at one time
options_en: both had happened at one time
questions.explanation: The past perfect had had marks the lunch as complete before she arrived.
questions.explanation_ar: الماضي التام had had يحدد أن الغداء اكتمل قبل وصولها.

questions.question: After the students had recalled events, they wrote stories. Which came first?
options: both of them at the same time
options_en: both of them at the same time
questions.explanation: The past perfect after after shows the recalling was complete before the writing.
questions.explanation_ar: الماضي التام بعد after يدل على أن الاسترجاع اكتمل قبل الكتابة.

questions.question: Which is the past participle of 'write'?
questions.explanation: Write has the irregular pattern write, wrote, written.
questions.explanation_ar: الفعل write شاذ: write و wrote و written.

questions.question: In 'I had had lunch', why are there two 'had'?
options: the first is main, the second auxiliary
both of them are auxiliary verbs here
both of them are really main verbs
the first is auxiliary, the second main
options_en: the first is main, the second auxiliary
both of them are auxiliary verbs here
both of them are really main verbs
the first is auxiliary, the second main
questions.explanation: The first had is the auxiliary and the second is the main verb have in its participle form.
questions.explanation_ar: had الأولى مساعد والثانية الفعل الرئيسي have بصيغة اسم المفعول.

questions.question: I didn't answer because I hadn't heard him. Which event is earlier?
questions.explanation: The past perfect hadn't heard marks the failure to hear before the failure to answer.
questions.explanation_ar: الماضي التام hadn't heard يحدد عدم السماع قبل عدم الرد.

questions.question: I hadn't left my country until I visited Canada. Which came first?
questions.explanation: The visit is the point where the long period of not leaving ended.
questions.explanation_ar: الزيارة هي النقطة التي انتهت عندها فترة عدم المغادرة.

questions.question: Which tense marks the event already completed on a timeline?
questions.explanation: On a timeline the past perfect sits further back, marking the completed earlier event.
questions.explanation_ar: على الخط الزمني يقع الماضي التام أبعد للخلف، فيحدد الحدث الأسبق المكتمل.

questions.question: In a two-event sentence, the simple past usually marks...
questions.explanation: The simple past carries the later event while the past perfect carries the earlier one.
questions.explanation_ar: الماضي البسيط يحمل الحدث اللاحق بينما الماضي التام يحمل الأسبق.
